itemListElement.name: n8n Pricing: Cloud Plans and Self-Hosting

mainEntity.name: How much does n8n cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: The public annual-billing prices checked on November 5, 2026 are €20/month for Starter, €50/month for Pro and €667/month for Business. Business is self-hosted only. Enterprise pricing is custom.

mainEntity.name: Does n8n have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: n8n offers a self-hosted Community Edition under its Sustainable Use License and a Cloud trial. The trial is not a permanent free Cloud plan.

mainEntity.name: Does n8n charge per node or workflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: n8n Cloud counts a full workflow run as one execution. A workflow with many nodes still counts as one execution each time it runs.

mainEntity.name: Is n8n Business a Cloud plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The current pricing page marks Business as self-hosted only. Enterprise can be hosted by n8n or self-hosted.

The Community Edition has no listed software subscription price, but server, database, backups, security and maintenance still cost money. The Sustainable Use License also limits some commercial uses.
